capabilities: Open a card desk instead of the file explorer
Map vault folders to configurable room cards
Create notes and child rooms from cards
Apply a mint glass and serif look with separate switches
Hide skipped folder paths from cards and recents
extras: Settings default to Chinese and must be switched to English manually; the README also includes developer release/publish instructions and notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's file tree is a plain hierarchical list, which gives no visual, room-like overview of a vault's folders and recent notes.
summary: Card-desk homepage that replaces the file explorer with folder-mapped rooms of note cards and applies a glass visual theme.
